title: Manager II, Engineering - Confluent
description:
Your Role and Responsibilities: About the Role The Connect Cloud Platform team owns the control plane that powers every connector running in Confluent Cloud, giving customers a reliable way to create, configure, and manage their connectors. The team also owns hybrid connector management, which extends this control plane so customers can manage on prem Connect clusters from Confluent Cloud through a single pane of glass, and contributes to the ongoing architectural evolution of the control plane as Connect scales. As an Engineering Manager II, you will own a team of senior and junior engineers building this control plane. Correctness is paramount in this domain: the team is accountable for making sure every connector request is processed reliably and that customer intent is honored consistently, given the cost and compliance implications of getting it wrong. You will partner closely with product, peer engineering teams across Confluent Cloud and Confluent Platform, and adjacent platform teams, to turn customer and product needs into a clear roadmap and a team that executes against it with a high bar for operational excellence. What You Will Do Own execution for the Connect control plane, including connector lifecycle APIs and the underlying metadata and state management, while partnering on the hybrid connector management initiative that extends this ownership. Partner with product management, engineering leadership, and cross functional stakeholders to define quarterly milestones and drive delivery of multi quarter roadmap commitments. Break down complex, cross team initiatives into meaningful milestones, surface dependencies and blockers early, and keep execution aligned to business priorities as requirements evolve. Lead a team of both senior and junior engineers, creating clarity on goals, providing regular coaching and feedback, and helping individuals grow in line with the career progression guide. Own the health of the team's on call and operational practices, including incident response, root cause reviews, and reducing recurring operational toil, given the team sits directly in the path of every connector operation customers run. Represent the team in technical discussions, design reviews, and postmortems, and help raise the bar for architecture, execution, and engineering process across the broader Connect organization. Translate product asks and customer needs into engineering requirements and delivery plans that balance feature velocity, technical debt, reliability, and long term architectural integrity. Build a healthy, inclusive, high trust team culture with psychological safety, strong engagement, and clear accountability. Partner with recruiting to attract, assess, and close strong engineering talent, while maintaining a high hiring bar and a strong candidate experience. Required Education: Bachelor's Degree Preferred education Master's Degree Required Technical and Professional Expertise: 8+ years of relevant software engineering experience and 2+ years of people management experience leading engineers in distributed systems, platform, or infrastructure focused teams. Strong technical depth in distributed systems, with the ability to weigh in credibly on API design, data consistency, and operational trade offs. Experience delivering multi quarter or cross team initiatives with clear business impact, including managing dependencies, shifting priorities, and execution risk. Proven ability to lead through ambiguity, align teams around outcomes, and keep work moving even while strategy is still being refined. Demonstrated strength in coaching, feedback, performance management, and career development for engineers across different levels of seniority. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across engineering, product, and other cross functional partners. Experience hiring and building balanced, high performing teams with strong attention to inclusion, team health, and long term talent development. Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. Preferred Technical and Professional Experience: Experience with Apache Kafka, Kafka Connect, Confluent Platform, or adjacent streaming and data integration technologies. title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
description:
Role & responsibilities We are looking for a Senior Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) to drive system reliability, scalability, and operational excellence across our production environments. This is a hands-on, high-impact Individual Contributor role where you will: Own production reliability and availability Define and enforce SRE practices and standards Lead incident response and operational excellence Coach and guide engineers on building reliable systems You will play a critical role in ensuring systems are measurable, observable, resilient, and scalable. Core SRE Responsibilities Reliability Engineering & System Health Ensure high availability, reliability, and fault tolerance of distributed systems. Define and implement: Service Level Indicators (SLIs) Service Level Objectives (SLOs) Error Budgets Continuously improve system reliability using data-driven approaches. Track and improve key reliability metrics: Availability Error rates Latency Observability, Monitoring & APM Build and maintain end-to-end observability systems: Metrics Logs Distributed tracing Implement effective: Monitoring Alerting (low noise, high signal) Use APM tools to track: Latency Error rates Service dependencies Scalability & Performance Engineering Ensure systems scale efficiently under load. Perform: Capacity planning Load testing & performance tuning Optimize for: Latency Throughput Resource utilization Automation & Toil Reduction Identify and eliminate manual, repetitive operational tasks (toil). Build automation for: Incident response Remediation workflows System recovery Improve engineering productivity through self-healing systems. Security & Reliability Integration Ensure systems follow secure-by-design principles. Integrate reliability with: Security controls Compliance requirements Partner with security teams on incident handling and risk mitigation. Coaching & Technical Leadership Mentor engineers on: SRE principles Production readiness Reliability engineering Drive adoption of SRE best practices across teams. Influence architecture for resilient system design. Operational Excellence & Incident Management Own and lead production incident management (L2/L3 support). Act as Incident Commander during critical outages. Drive blameless postmortems (RCA) and ensure action closure. Improve: Mean Time to Detect (MTTD) Mean Time to Recover (MTTR) Mean Time Between Failures (MTBF) Establish strong on-call practices, runbooks, and escalation mechanisms. Key Reliability Metrics (Must Have Experience) Candidates must have hands-on experience defining, measuring, and improving: Availability (%) Mean Time Between Failures (MTBF) Mean Time to Recovery (MTTR) Mean Time to Failure (MTTF) Error Rates / Failure Rates SLO Compliance Error Budget Management Customer Impact Metrics (user-facing reliability) CI/CD & Automated Testing Ensure reliable and safe deployments through: Automated testing (unit, integration, reliability testing) Automated deployment pipelines Improve deployment success rate and rollback mechanisms. Support progressive delivery (canary, blue/green deployments). Disaster Recovery & Resilience Design and validate Disaster Recovery (DR) strategies. Define and test: RTO (Recovery Time Objective) RPO (Recovery Point Objective) Conduct failure testing / chaos engineering where applicable. Required Qualifications 510 years of experience, with minimum 3+ years in a dedicated SRE role Strong experience in: Production systems ownership Incident management & on-call Root Cause Analysis (RCA) Hands-on experience with: Reliability metrics (SLO/SLI/Error Budgets) Observability & monitoring systems Performance and scalability engineering Strong experience with: AWS cloud Kubernetes (EKS) in production DevOps and Platform Engineering Proficiency in one programming language (Go, Python, Java) Proven ability to handle and resolve high-severity production incidents 
 Preferred candidate profile Experience in chaos engineering / resilience testing Strong background in APM tools (Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, etc.) Experience defining organization-wide SRE practices Experience mentoring engineers and leading reliability initiatives Ideal Candidate Profile We are looking for engineers who: Have owned production systems end-to-end Have led incidents and handled outages Have defined and worked with SLOs and error budgets Think in terms of system reliability, not just infrastructure

 As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you'll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale.
   

  

 Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world's toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.
   

  

 The Position
   

  

 This position is available in the DAIV System Team, a centralized DevOps and software infrastructure team based in Bangalore and supporting multiple software product development teams across the EMEA region. These teams develop desktop and web applications for data management, image processing, and visualization workflows. The DAIV System Team provides CI/CD infrastructure, software lifecycle management, developer tooling, AI enablement, and cybersecurity support across the software development lifecycle. As a DevOps Engineer, you will contribute to the CI/CD, software lifecycle management, developer tooling, AI enablement, and cybersecurity capabilities used by desktop and web product teams. Working with senior engineers and technical leads, you will implement automation, support product teams, resolve delivery issues, and build brad experience across modern DevOps technologies.
   

  

 How You Will Make an Impact
   

  

 You will help development teams deliver software more efficiently by maintaining reliable pipelines, automating repetitive work, and resolving build and deployment issues.
   

  

 You will contribute to secure, consistent engineering practices while learning how complex desktop and web products are built, tested, packaged, and released.
   

  

 You will work in an international, collaborative environment with opportunities to develop technical depth in a desktop or web application track.
   

  

 In This Role You Will
   

  

* Implement, maintain, monitor, and troubleshoot CI/CD pipelines and supporting DevOps infrastructure under the guidance of senior engineers and technical leads.
* Support product teams with build, test, packaging, deployment, release, and software lifecycle management activities.
* Create and maintain scripts, pipeline components, automation, and documentation that reduce manual effort and improve consistency.
* Support GitHub or GitLab repositories, runners or agents, artifact management, access patterns, and related developer tooling.
* Investigate build, pipeline, deployment, environment, and release failures; document findings and implement agreed corrective actions.
* Contribute to secure SDLC practices by operating automated code, dependency, container, and secrets scanning and assisting with vulnerability remediation.
* Participate in upgrades, migrations, patching, and deprecation activities for development tools, operating systems, build environments, containers, and platform components.
* Use approved AI\-assisted engineering tools to improve development, testing, documentation, troubleshooting, and automation activities.
* Collaborate with DevOps engineers, software engineers, architects, cybersecurity specialists, and product stakeholders to deliver prioritized improvements.
* Follow engineering standards, review processes, configuration management practices, and operational procedures.
* Share knowledge, seek feedback, and continuously develop technical skills across the supported technology stacks.
* Participate in Agile planning, team reviews, and continuous improvement activities.


 The Candidate
   

  

 The ideal candidate is a practical and curious software or DevOps engineer with solid engineering fundamentals, a strong learning mindset, and the discipline to build reliable, maintainable automation.
   

  

 Besides that, you have:
   

  

* Bachelor's or master's degree with 3 to 6 years of DevOps industry experience.
* Preferred fields of study: Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field.
* Experience with software development or DevOps fundamentals, including version control, CI/CD, scripting, automated testing, and systematic troubleshooting.
* Hands\-on experience with Git and at least one CI/CD platform such as GitHub Actions or GitLab CI/CD, including basic pipeline maintenance and artifact or package management.
* Experience with several of the following core technologies: Python, .NET, Docker, and Linux.
* Exposure to at least one application track is beneficial: desktop delivery using CMake, C\+\+/Qt, PowerShell, and Windows build environments; or web delivery using Kubernetes, Helm, Rancher, and containerized application platforms.
* Understanding of software security principles and secure SDLC practices, including dependency management, secrets protection, automated scanning, vulnerability remediation, and quality controls.
* Interest in using approved generative AI capabilities responsibly to improve development, testing, documentation, troubleshooting, and automation activities.
* Ability to analyze problems, follow through on technical tasks, document solutions, and learn new technologies quickly.
* Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate in cross\-functional, distributed teams.
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
* Experience with Agile methodologies such as Scrum or SAFe is beneficial.
* Travel may occasionally be required for collaboration with global teams.

Must have a strong work ethic, time management skills, and a positive attitude. Ability to work independently or on a team with minimal supervision.
